title: TheRegularScheduled2WeekMcPhase
description: A small Vanilla+ modpack that slightly increases difficulty aswell.
body:
# Description
A lightly modded Minecraft experience that (mostly) keeps the vanilla feel while adding some automation, enhancing terrain generation, exploration, difficulty and realistic weather. Built for the mandatory, regular scheduled two week Minecraft phase.

## Features
- Create & Add-ons: Mechanical automation that doesn't feel too out of place in a vanilla+ modpack
- Enhanced World Generation: Some (not so) subtle changes to structures and terrain for a more diverse overworld, nether and end
- Quality of Life: Inventory sorting and other tweaks, tooltips, JEI and a bunch of performance mods for a smooth experience
- Difficulty: Mobs will get stronger over time and can spawn as special variants with various effects.
- Weather: Protomanly's Weather mod provides realistic weather, so make sure your house is not made out of haybales, or it might just get blown away
